cause:a-mod-side-cause-drain-refuses-uno.text: A mod-side cause: drain refuses unordered brine, StandingOrders is Fill-only, and pour fails on switch, so the mod paths were ruled out; the fault was a harness bystander freed by the vanilla AutoUndrafter.

cause:a-stale-lay-was-not-the-cause-a.text: A stale lay was not the cause: a fresh re-lay repeats the wall crossing.

cause:basic-pump-s-levelspercycle-defaul.text: Basic pump's levelsPerCycle defaults to 1 (no RM_PumpExtension), and one level is 5 units, so Pour moved exactly the gravity rate; the stations at levelsPerCycle 2 and 4 were already faster, so the stations were not the problem.

cause:c1-f6-hose-link-signature-scan-cos.text: C1-F6, hose-link signature scan cost: not a bug. RM_HoseLinks.Refresh runs once per map per tick (checkedTick) and is O(reels).

cause:c5-f1-flood-fed-driver-inputs-not-.text: C5-F1 (flood-fed driver inputs not saved): driver-input marks only seed flow ORDER for a 5000-tick window, no volume is lost, so no change was made.

cause:c5-f2-refused-cells-forgotten-on-r.text: C5-F2 (refused cells forgotten on reload) is not a bug: a forgotten refusal is re-offered once after load, spends no volume and re-decides by current state (documented at IsFrontCell).

cause:c7a-f8-corridor-hash-walking-the-w.text: C7a-F8, corridor hash walking the whole bounding rectangle: not a bug. The rect is bounded by maxLength<=80 and checked once per 250 ticks per laid reel.

cause:c7b-f6-interrupting-a-wind-removes.text: C7b-F6 (interrupting a wind removes whole trailing cells) is not a bug: inward rounding is the fuzz invariant and nothing is lost.

cause:c7b-f7-unbounded-carried-trail-his.text: C7b-F7, unbounded carried-trail history: not a bug. The trail grows only while PulledLength<=MaxLength and revisits truncate; Pulled is O(n) in open ground and ShortenBy runs only while winding. A 1600-cell serpentine needs deliberate micro.

cause:c8b-f2-show-find-assigning-a-surfa.text: C8b-F2: Show/Find assigning a surfaceLook to a lookless def just by reading it is not a bug; reading Find confirmed it never assigns a look on read.

cause:defining-own-rm-affordances-was-re.text: Defining own RM_ affordances was rejected: donor buildings check their own affordance names, so an RM_ substitute would do nothing and nothing in FlowWorks checks these affordances.

cause:gss-s-power-tap-twin-is-not-affect.text: GSS's power-tap twin is not affected by the same defect: its clamp is 1x1, and POWER_THEFT A2 caught on the first cycle.

cause:harness-oracle-fault-pre-solve-n-d.text: Harness/oracle fault (pre-solve n*D bars): refuted. validation_v2 --mock gave the same 5 fails while G_every_cell_vs_oracle passed, so engine==oracle and the fault was in the mod.

cause:idle-or-drafted-colonists-left-on-.text: Idle or drafted colonists left on cells later scripts dig was the first hypothesis; the mechanism found was park_bystanders walking everyone across the river at z~94 on the fish map, so they were swimming and carried downstream.

cause:it-was-not-a-pipe-centrestub-corne.text: It was not a pipe CentreStub/CornerStub/RiserStub or a hose DrawPortStub; it was reel o1's link (hose layer, HosePortRule.Feed). Reel 41679 footprint (18,42,2,2) has port RM_UniversalPipe.

cause:kernel-oracle-fail-in-the-sweep-wa.text: kernel_oracle FAIL in the sweep was not a kernel/oracle defect: it was a staged-build error from mid-edit ExcavationTickChecks.cs, and kernel_oracle is green standalone.

cause:l5-colonists-clean-spill-unmeasure.text: L5_colonists_clean_spill UNMEASURED on run 20261018T233414 was a harness fault, not the mod: the precondition demanded Cleaning priority readBack 1 while vanilla stores 3 with manual priorities off; filth went 9 -> 0 in 750 ticks.

cause:mod-regression-deep-beds-not-laid-.text: MOD regression (deep beds not laid): refuted. RecordLakeFloor ran (AnyMovingWater false); the seeded R11 draw was silted, 'deepest 2 m', and lakeDepthScale scales only the excess over 2 m. Result is SITE.

cause:not-reproduced-selftest-flowworks-.text: Not reproduced: selftest_flowworks_stock ran 1036/1036 GREEN alone (430 s); the nightly red (640 s) was attributed to suite load.

cause:p3f-p4f-were-not-a-mod-fault-proof.text: P3f/P4f were not a mod fault: ProofForcedFlyer launched ThingDefOf.PawnFlyer (no stun), a deliberate jump, which lands safely since 0bed9b5796 (pitJumpLandsSafe).

cause:pan-nothing-as-a-mod-fault-refuted.text: pan=nothing as a mod fault: refuted. RM_PlacerProof.SelfCheck pans once at 5-11% hit chance (0.125*(0.4+0.06*Mining)), so nothing was the expected answer; it also pans after 5 washes drained the stock (11.2 -> 0.2).

cause:rl4-fail-on-west-inlet-was-a-mod.text: RL4 FAIL on west_inlet was a mod hose fault: the capture showed the coupler on the brass inlet, so a stale harness window was presumed (unproven); the window fix then passed RL4.

cause:s3-w4-limitless-true-was-not-a-cla.text: S3 W4 limitless=True was not a classifier bug: W4 is a 40-cell EDGE body, and 392300ef0d (RM_StockMath.IsLimitlessByWetness) makes every edge body limitless however small.

cause:source-regression-in-the-mod-the-f.text: Source regression in the mod: the failures were harness faults. Rain filled the P pits and drowned the P_walk colonist (PIT_FILL_EFFECTS_1 working), fleshbeasts killed the idle control colonist, and P3 counted map-wide descents.

cause:spores-as-the-cause-of-the-bruise-.text: Spores as the cause of the Bruise/Crack on the parked, drafted pawn Vikinger: ruled out, the pawn was still hurt (ended 160,95 with Bruise + Crack) after the spore purge.

cause:stale-row-the-failure-was-not-mere.text: Stale row: the failure was not merely an out-of-date result; a re-run still failed (class HARNESS+MOD, not stale).

cause:t-pit-cover-going-red-was-not-a.text: T_PIT_COVER going red was not a FlowWorks pit-cover defect: GSS changed a RebuildContacts signature that the source-text check pinned. Fixed upstream in cf6efc3055, and the check now reads the compiled DLL and stays green when a RebuildContacts parameter is added.

cause:the-10-18-t6-fail-dehydration-0-07.text: The 10-18 T6 FAIL (dehydration 0.075 against 0.30 expected) was not a mod defect: it traced to the harness before fix 025f7fdbfa, in which the pawn was not drafted and drank.

cause:the-7cae6d72be18-live-fail-row-125.text: The 7cae6d72be18 live fail 'row 125,125 lacks dl/fluid' was not a missing C# field: the C# row has dl and fluid, but on a dry cell FluidAt is null and the RimBridge JSON transport omits null members, so fluid is absent, not null; the judge's 'fluid not in r' check misread this.

cause:the-97-fail-lines-of-the-2026-10.text: The 97 FAIL lines of the 2026-10-07 run are not 97 separate components: phases repeat, and the E3/E4/E6/G cluster starting from 'pulse-0 vector != oracle state' is a probable single cascade from A0_instrument (labelled HARNESS).

cause:the-chunk-4-nothing-landed-note-is.text: The chunk-4 'nothing landed' note is stale: 77ef94208d had already landed in an earlier run.

cause:the-first-a4-attempt-s-failure-wat.text: The first A4 attempt's failure (water never past the first connector square in 63,000 pulses) was not the network cost: every square between the edge strip and the plot sits in the map-edge SINK band (isSink true at x<=9), which eats the front. The inland-source run wetted all 6400 squares.

cause:the-first-build-had-pipes-join-onl.text: The first build had pipes join only on a side or under, never a corner. The owner corrected this: pipes join whenever adjacent, corners included.

cause:the-half-full-backup-was-probably-.text: The half-full backup was probably never real in game: the old case's 12/24 came from its per-square model; with the game's canal-wide walk the old pour held 22.5/24 (offline twin, not live).

cause:the-harness-placed-the-site-wrongl.text: The harness placed the site wrongly: extension_proof.py and extensions_rivers.py pass no site, only call ProofWeirPool(arg).

cause:the-hostile-arrival-was-not-on-the.text: The hostile arrival was not on the test map: the triggers carry map uid 3, a leftover rejected river_site candidate (tile 13722), while the test map was uid 9. The swarm had fresh ids, so it was generated then, not at map-gen.

cause:the-l5-run-1-miss-was-not-a.text: The L5 run 1 miss was not a mod fault: its 300-tick wait was shorter than the 375-tick flow lease.

cause:the-live8-fail-mod-on-lower-only-f.text: The live8 FAIL MOD on LOWER_ONLY_FROM_WINCH and RAID_UP was later resolved: the 2026-10-22 belt run passed 12/12 including RAID_UP assault+sapper.

cause:the-melt-row-passing-with-no-ice-w.text: The melt row passing with no ice was not a mod result: it read the pond's own fill water, so it passed with no ice anywhere.

cause:the-mod-was-not-at-fault-the-fails.text: The mod was not at fault: the FAILs were a stale harness expectation, since walking into an uncovered ladderless D=4 pit is refused by the 2026-10-06 ruling and v2 P3 proves walk-in is refused.

cause:the-night-live-tank-loop-on-fail-p.text: The night-live tank_loop_on FAIL 'pour-in never ran' was not a mod bug: it was harness. Unasked pour happens only into a Fill-mode tank and the new tank was Store. The spawn_batch 'madeFromStuff but stuff=null' was log noise, not the cause.

cause:the-p3f-p4b-fails-were-not-a-mod.text: The P3f/P4b FAILs were not a mod defect: the default-on rescue ladder in the pit caused them.

cause:the-river-site-never-sweeps-a-pawn.text: The river site never sweeps a pawn / the site rock holds no placer mineral (SITE classification): refuted. river_site.py drafted colonists on dry ground at z=30 and no chain put a pawn in the current, so pending=0 was guaranteed; the mod path StepOne -> WashAway -> TakenByLand.Take reads correct.

cause:the-route-planner-entering-wall-ce.text: The route planner entering wall cells was not the cause: RouteCells/CordPlanner walk walkable cells only. The shaping stages and string-pulling accepted wall-seam poses because Clear's depth was per-cell.

cause:the-row-s-worker-caused-the-late-b.text: The row's worker caused the late bucket: settleJobs showed only Wait_Wander/GotoWander/Wait_MaintainPosture, never a fill or pour job.

cause:the-run1-off1-miss-in-driver-6-was.text: The run1 off1 miss in driver 6 was a harness fault (lazy snapshot), not a mod fault.

cause:the-scene-s-toss-check-could-never.text: The scene's toss check could never pass because it looked only for vanilla Fire on the square. A lit canal carries RM_LiquidFlame instead, and chemfuel can burn out within the 1200-tick wait, so _toss was changed to poll ProofCell burning=True.

cause:the-steward-s-claim-that-the-pawn-.text: The steward's claim that the pawn never reached the pads (drafted colonist cannot path into a ladderless pit) is wrong for the pads: the pawn did reach every pad (cell and depth match in the call log). It was only true of the swim and control rows.

cause:the-t13-reopen-notes-s3da9d64afd-s.text: The T13 'reopen' notes (S3da9d64afd, S73995370fc) do not hold: they are NEW failure signatures, not retired failures returning. The T13 failures of 10-29 are new, not the retired 10-26 one.

cause:the-tap-backs-up-at-half-full-chan.text: The 'tap backs up at half-full channel' problem was probably never real in the game: the old test's 12/24 came from its per-square pour model, and with the game's own pour walk the old whole-level pour already held 22.5/24 (measured offline, not in game).

cause:the-throw-was-not-flowworks-code-i.text: The throw was not FlowWorks code: it is a vanilla 1.6 Odyssey bug. RM_Patch_LiquidHeatTerrainChanged was only listed on the Harmony stack of the patched TerrainGrid.DoTerrainChangedEffects and never ran, because the original threw first.

cause:the-title-s-open-question-mod-vs-a.text: The title's open question 'MOD vs ArrayWorld gap vs superseded property' was settled as a real level-set kernel bug in the mod.

cause:the-two-failures-were-not-caused-b.text: The two failures were not caused by SUMP_TAR_FIRE_NETWORK_1's fire-gate diff; the cases were stale tests, and both pass without source or test changes at 14b5a573688a.

cause:the-walk-claimed-the-flood-never-c.text: The walk claimed the flood 'never' calls SetTerrain; refuted: CoolFrontToGlass calls it by design for coolsToGlassEdge fluids (tar glass).

cause:the-weir-sat-at-the-map-edge-findw.text: The weir sat at the map edge: FindWeirSite already skips a margin of 12 cells and z=12 is the first allowed row. Earlier runs pooled at that row (cells 14, 16, 23); only the pre-margin run at (79,0,0) failed from the edge.

cause:undecided-site-vs-mod-only-by-one-.text: Undecided SITE-vs-MOD only by one live print. - The "weir at the map edge" reading is REFUTED. `FindWeirSite` (`src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Source/Rivers/RM_RiverWorksProofWorks.cs:24-69`) already skips a margin of `weirPoolLength + 4` = 12 cells (`RM_RiversSettings.cs:57`, default 8); […]

finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.accept: none, ticket filed no acceptance test
finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.proposed_fix: Evaluate the origin at the deck's walking height instead of the raw excavation depth in RM_SuperdeepTrap.cs IsFallingArrival (line ~786), so deck-to-hole shoves register as descents.
finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.text: With pitRelativeClimbEnabled off, IsFallingArrival compares raw ExcavatedDepthAt(prev) and ExcavatedDepthAt(pos). A pawn shoved from a deck over a superdeep excavation into an uncovered square of the same excavation reads 4->4, so no descent: no fall damage, no spike descent event.

finding:ALL_OFF_FIX_DEPTH_ENGINE_STAYS_O.accept: none, ticket filed no acceptance test
finding:ALL_OFF_FIX_DEPTH_ENGINE_STAYS_O.proposed_fix: Make _setting_in (extensions.py:352-359) handle the depth-engine switch as _setting() (lines 334-338) does, setting depthEngineLiveForTests alongside depthEngineEnabled.
finding:ALL_OFF_FIX_DEPTH_ENGINE_STAYS_O.text: _setting_in writes depthEngineEnabled=False without depthEngineLiveForTests, so on a normally loaded game the engine stays on. The all_off fixture is not all off and all_off_still_digs can report a false mod failure.

finding:AUTO_SPLICE_FIX_SKIPS_OBSTACLE_C.accept: none, ticket filed no acceptance test
finding:AUTO_SPLICE_FIX_SKIPS_OBSTACLE_C.proposed_fix: Pass a world obstacle predicate and band restrictions into MateTail/MatePair from RefreshMates, and add a maximum-length input to the splice API.
finding:AUTO_SPLICE_FIX_SKIPS_OBSTACLE_C.text: RefreshMates calls MateTail with blocked=null, so the automatic splice join between two open hose ends can be drawn through wall gaps. The splice API has no max-length input, so a join can exceed the reel's capacity. Render only.

finding:BIGNET_PROOF_FIX_SIZE_NOT_RESTOR.accept: none, ticket filed no acceptance test
finding:BIGNET_PROOF_FIX_SIZE_NOT_RESTOR.proposed_fix: Restore size from saved state in main (flow_bignet_live.py lines ~60, 97-110, 131-138) for the dig and pulse phases instead of using a.size.
finding:BIGNET_PROOF_FIX_SIZE_NOT_RESTOR.text: In flow_bignet_live.py only inland is restored from saved state. Resumed dig and pulse phases use the default --size 80 while the cell count comes from st["size"], so the proof can PASS without digging or wetting the intended far corner.

finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.accept: validation_v2 --live --fresh-map shows S5_sticky_limitless PASS (W6 sticky OFF limitless=False; twin W7 ON limitless=True).
finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.proposed_fix: none stated; presumed MOD fault in body classification with sticky limitless off.
finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.text: In validation_v2 run4, S5_sticky_limitless FAILED: W6 classified with stickyLimitless OFF never formed a body (limitless=None). A flowworks_body_report probe at W6 gave classified=false, formedByThisCall=false, indexAgrees=false, isSourceCell=true, no body. Twin W7 classified limitless with 64 cells.

finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.accept: A SelfTest/python case that goes red on old code and green with the fix; filed as GptFixesAChecks (selftest_flowworks_stock.py).
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.claim: Fill and wash now debit the body, spent bodies are skipped, and wear (hit points) is carried across container transitions. (recorded on pre-landing a6ce6a54db; landed as 51bcdabdb8a0)
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.proposed_fix: Debit the body in the fill and wash jobs (RM_LiquidStock), skip spent bodies, and copy HitPoints in RM_LiquidBottleUtility.MakeContainer.
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.text: Filling a bottle/bucket/barrel from pond terrain and washing a container never debit the body's stock, so a bottle poured into a tank creates liquid from a limited pond. Every container transition makes a fresh Thing without HitPoints, healing it.

finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.accept: extension_proof.py --live --site dry --chains plot_C_limitless_canal: canal_fill_front PASS (mouth wet, far<=3).
finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.proposed_fix: RM_FlowKernel.creepWaterEnabled (setting waterFrontCreepEnabled, default on): a cell that received water this pulse cannot donate it on, so the front advances 1 cell/pulse from the mouth.
finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.text: A flat dead-end canal channel wets the far end first. The owner wants the wet front to move out from the mouth.

finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.accept: validation_v2 --live on calm: 61 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 UNMEASURED, with the 5 canal fill rows PASS.
finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.proposed_fix: CellKey keeps the wet mouth, and levelSet forbids the drop-of-1 swap. A mouth beside a supplying source never counts as wet (kernel and oracle).
finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.text: Since the level solve, source-fed canals wet only their first cell: a fed D=1 run sat at 1,0,0,0. Five validation_v2 fill rows failed: E2_channels_fill_every_direction, E3b_recession_shipped, E2s_shared_source_both_fill, E3_budget_exhaustion, E3n_budget_off_supplies.

finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.accept: Live: warm map, low-joy colonist beside a shallow poison canal with no other water; read the GoSwimming job target.
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.claim: Patches/Canals/FlowWorks_NoRecreationalSwim.xml marks 44 hazardous fill tiers (oil, poison, blood, chemfuel, astrofuel, boiling water, slimes, tar) with RM_NoRecreationalSwimExtension, which the GoSwimming patch vetoes; plain and icy water stay swimmable. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.proposed_fix: Mark the hazardous fill tiers with RM_NoRecreationalSwimExtension via Patches/Canals/FlowWorks_NoRecreationalSwim.xml.
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.text: Poison/oil/fuel canal fills keep the Water tag and carry no no-swim marker, so colonists may go recreational swimming in them.

finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.accept: selftest_flowworks_fuel_moat.py case chemfuel_registry_names_canal_fluid: red on the old registry, green with the fix.
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.claim: b0ec1721ff wired canal fluids for chemfuel and astrofuel. The owner's card also added chemfuel inferno and astrofuel chained detonation (1a5a2ceee7) and the Utinni raid and Visibility rise (6238e06206). (recorded on pre-landing 6e4fc00401; landed as 35743b48eed2)
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.proposed_fix: Add canalFluid to the chemfuel/astrofuel rows (RM_Liquid_Chemfuel at :458) in RM_LiquidDefRegistry.xml, pointing at the existing RM_Fluid_* defs.
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.text: Chemfuel and astrofuel (and propane) rows in RM_LiquidDefRegistry.xml carry no canalFluid although RM_Fluid_Chemfuel/RM_Fluid_Astrofuel exist, so fuel cannot be pumped into a moat and spills instead (RM_LiquidSpill).

finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.accept: Selftest Concealed_cover_does_not_shield_the_pawn_beneath_it_from_the_fill passes (L0); live: a pawn beneath a concealed lid in a toxic or deep-filled pit gains toxic buildup or drowns as an uncovered pawn would (L1).
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.claim: Fixed in source (e3b0a513a649 (pre-landing; landed as 8c8bd865f358)): a concealed cover no longer shields the pawn beneath it from the fill; selftest red-then-green.
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.proposed_fix: Make UnderDeck/SplashShare (RM_SuspensionPatches.cs:313-326) not give zero splash share to pawns beneath a solid cover, so RM_PitFillEffects.Tick poisons and drowns them.
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.text: UnderDeck recognizes only suspension floor-band pawns (InFloorBand). A pawn beneath a solid concealed cover is IsBeneath but gets SplashShare 0, so RM_PitFillEffects.Tick skips both poisoning and drowning.

finding:COVER_BLAST_FIX_DECK_LEFT_INTACT.accept: none, ticket filed no acceptance test
finding:COVER_BLAST_FIX_DECK_LEFT_INTACT.proposed_fix: Spring the connected deck when a blast kills a cover (in DeSpawn or the RM_Patch_ExplosionBreaksPitCover postfix), not only when a cover survives. Building_PitCover.cs:146-182,289-293.
finding:COVER_BLAST_FIX_DECK_LEFT_INTACT.text: A blast that kills a cover before the explosion postfix runs leaves the rest of the connected deck standing. DeSpawn drops only that cell's riders, and the postfix then finds no cover. A weaker blast that leaves the first cover alive springs the whole deck.

finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.accept: A SelfTest/python case red on old code and green with the fix, per finding.
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.claim: C4-F3: a cover with a lower-id cardinal neighbour returns before flooding. C4-F5: a mixed deck springs at its weakest cover's rating. C4-F6: no 400 cap on Deck(). The inspect line still shows each cover's own rating. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.proposed_fix: Return early for a cover with a lower-id cardinal neighbour so only local minima flood; spring a mixed deck at its weakest cover's rating; remove the 400 cap on Deck().
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.text: Every pit cover floods its whole deck every scan (O(N^2) on big covered moats). A mixed-tier deck springs at the lead cover's tier (lowest thingID). Decks over 400 covers are census-truncated, giving several leads and partial collapse.

finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.accept: A SelfTest/python case red on old code and green with the fix (GptFixesAChecks, selftest_flowworks_stock.py).
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.claim: dbh_water now only on plain waters (generator and 15 terrain files); full DBH is gated in (strings verified in its 1.6 DLL). (recorded on pre-landing 80ac4bda4b; landed as 579306aad895)
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.proposed_fix: Tag dbh_water only on plain waters (generator plus terrain files) and gate full DBH in alongside Lite. The bucket value is not fixable in XML (WaterExt is per ThingDef).
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.text: Acid, propane, tar, slime and poisoned-water terrains carry DBH's dbh_water tag, making them wash/drink sources. Bucket DBH water value is fixed at 5 while material scales contents. DBH integration fires only for 'Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite', not full DBH.

finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.accept: deep_lake_proof.py <out> --fresh-map on DLL dbc55e224cd8 or later: DL_lake_over_4000_is_limited passes; DL_drained_reads_gradual_hollow PASS (deepestDry > 4, lakebedAbyss > 0) with both colonist rows measured.
finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.proposed_fix: No mod change. Harness: the form reports the generator's draw, a draw at the notch retries the next origin, and the MOD row judges record == draw.
finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.text: A painted 5184-square lake with deep beds on read deepest=4, bedSum=19080, where the 2026-10-22 belt read 12. DL_lake_over_4000_is_limited and DL_drained_reads_gradual_hollow FAILED and both colonist rows were UNMEASURED.

finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.accept: Live: a thirsty pawn beside deep sand does not drink it (L1).
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.claim: Drink half only (bd36286c4795 (pre-landing; landed as 015b7892e833)): pawns no longer drink deep sand. The IsNaturalLiquid C# pond-source half is not fixed.
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.proposed_fix: Stop deep sand reading as fresh water for drinking; make RM_MapComponent_Excavation.IsNaturalLiquid exclude RM_DeepSand as a pond source.
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.text: RM_DeepSand carries a Freshwater body and Water tag (for fishing), so it counts as fresh water for drinking (IsWater && !IsOcean) and as a pond source accepted by the excavation. Pumps and canals beside it treat sand as natural liquid.

finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.accept: deep_stone_live.py --fresh-map logs a job_probe hasJobOnCell RM_DigCanalJob plus an accepted order, depth 3->4, and scores DS_superdeep_cut.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.claim: Harness now probes the job and sends ordered_job. The order is accepted and hasJobOnCell RM_DigCanalJob is logged, but depth still stayed 3 in 6000 ticks, so the cut row is not yet measured. (recorded on pre-landing 1edfffa47149; landed as b61e5f66b486)
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.proposed_fix: Force a colonist onto the job (jawa/prioritized_work or ordered_job on the designation) instead of waiting on the AI scan; read the job taken before the clock starts.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.text: deep_stone_live.py --fresh-map scores DS_superdeep_cut_turns_up_deep_stone UNMEASURED/SITE: no colonist cut the square in 6000 ticks. An RM_DigCanal designation was added at a depth-3 square, depth stayed [3,3], DIGFINDS 0 before/after.

finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.accept: Rerun deep_stone_live.py --fresh-map live: job_probe reply carries workGiver and pawn blocks, dig accepted, depth 3->4.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.claim: The probe call now passes pawnId=, and a selftest scans the kwargs against tool_schemas. The live rerun shows the job_probe reply with workGiver (RM_DigCanalWorkGiver, hasJobOnCell, RM_DigCanalJob) and pawn blocks, and the order accepted. Depth stayed 3 over 6000 ticks, so A1 is not verified.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.proposed_fix: Pass pawnId= in the probe call, and add a selftest that the probe kwargs match the tool signature. Then rerun --fresh-map and expect dig accepted, depth 3->4.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.text: deep_stone_live.py:149 calls jawa/flowworks_job_probe with pawn=, but the tool's parameter is pawnId. The pawn is dropped, the WorkGiver half never runs, and the row reads UNMEASURED/SITE 'hands this pawn no job' although the order was accepted.

finding:DEEP_STONE_PROOF_FIX_RERUN_LETTE.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test (it only records the defect).
finding:DEEP_STONE_PROOF_FIX_RERUN_LETTE.proposed_fix: Not stated in the record; the item only records the defect.
finding:DEEP_STONE_PROOF_FIX_RERUN_LETTE.text: deep_stone_live.py:176-177 requires a new 'Deep stone' first-find letter. RM_DigDiscovery.cs:161 found.Add fires once per def per map, so a correct rerun without --fresh-map has no second letter and reports MOD FAIL.

finding:DEPTH_PROOFS_FIX_EXIT_ZERO_ON_FA.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test (it only records the defect).
finding:DEPTH_PROOFS_FIX_EXIT_ZERO_ON_FA.proposed_fix: Not stated in the record; the item only records the defect. Implied: make main return nonzero when any row is FAIL.
finding:DEPTH_PROOFS_FIX_EXIT_ZERO_ON_FA.text: depth_rebuild_proofs.py:526 `main` returns 0 regardless of FAIL rows; only line 163 returns 2. A gate reading the exit code sees success after failed proofs, e.g. `--only p5` with a wrong liquid total or a nonlevel surface.

finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.accept: `modcheck FlowWorks dig_finds` via the testq lane steve-targeted on SteveDesktop (dry site): finds_off_none, cut_turns_up_local_find and first_find_sends_letter must each PASS. Standalone: quarry_find_live.py row QUARRY_FIND_DROPS_ON_LIP.
finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.proposed_fix: Not fixed. The leading hypothesis is that the x4 digLabourMultiplier makes cuts outlast the waits. Lengthen the waits or lower the labour multiplier in the proof, as droid_dig_live did with LABOUR = 0.25 and WAIT_TICKS = 15000.
finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.text: The dig_finds chain (finds_off_none, cut_turns_up_local_find, first_find_sends_letter) fails on SteveDesktop with 'ExpectationFailed: the dig job never finished' in all 29 fails from 2026-10-26 on. The standalone quarry_find_live.py A5 passed 2026-10-22.

finding:DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_MOAT_WITH_MANNE.accept: drawbridge_proof.py --fresh-map: all R13 live rows PASS (12/12 at 41fb948b5e). Plus the FlowWorks SelfTest DrawbridgeChecks, and an owner in-game look at timber and steel bridges.
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_MOAT_WITH_MANNE.proposed_fix: Follow design/RimMandrake/flowworks_drawbridge_design_2026-10-20.md §Ruled design (R1-R13). Force an immediate pocket-grid rebuild on toggle, keep a per-leaf versioned save record, and keep rigid pipe/conduit off leaves.
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_MOAT_WITH_MANNE.text: Build the ruled FlowWorks drawbridge (timber hand-winch, steel powered): bascule leaf, gate leaf and plank art. Raising tips riders to the hinge bank without Collapse. Peace mode auto-lowers and any free hostile locks it. Raiders get trench rules, winch sappers and raid planks.

finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test (it only records the defect).
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.proposed_fix: In Apply, after restoring the deck on lower, classify occupants as underneath, as Notify_DeckBuilt does for newly built decks.
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.text: Lowering a drawbridge leaf restores the deck cells without classifying pawns already on the floor beneath it into the floor band. They then read as on the deck: draw height, load, immersion protection and movement band change.

finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.accept: Live: pick the drill in Architect on a map with and without a yield and read the mouse text (live look owed). Offline: SelfTest 773/773, py 51/51.
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.claim: The drill/tap PlaceWorker now draws 'Subsurface: <liquid>, <litres> remaining' beside the mouse while placing, or in red 'nothing drillable under this map / reserve used up', plus a red line when drilling is off. Placement is not refused. Drill description says the survey shows while placing.
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.proposed_fix: Show the survey while placing (PlaceWorker readout beside the mouse / ghost text) or on the map's info, without changing placement behaviour.
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.text: The drill/tap subsurface survey (e.g. 'nothing drillable found under this map') is readable only on a built drill, so a player spends steel, components and 400 W to learn there is nothing to drill.

finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test (it only records the defect).
finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.proposed_fix: Make ExitInReach read StepDepthAt for the pawn's actual floor-band position, not the deck surface height above it (RM_PitFillEffects.cs:220-238).
finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.text: RM_Drowning.ExitInReach reads StepDepthAt of the decked square at deck height, so a floor-band pawn under a bridge is judged able to step to the undug bank and gets no drowning severity.

finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.accept: python.exe src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/northstar/legacy_fill_live.py --fresh-map: LF_fallback_hands_back_ground PASS, LF_fallback_off_leaves_trench PASS, LF_reload_trench_not_reread PASS.
finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.proposed_fix: Add a schema flag (RM_legacyRehydrationDone) and a fallback policy: an unrecorded filled-in cell gets the commonest non-channel non-liquid neighbour, else Soil (setting legacyFillFallbackEnabled).
finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.text: Legacy rehydration re-reads filled-back channel cells as excavations on reload, and filling a channel with no recorded original terrain left channel terrain instead of surrounding ground.

finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.accept: A SelfTest/python case or live state read that is red on old code and green with the fix: pair a ferry with the river empty, read RopeIndicesNoRebuild.Count and an undrafted path before any RopeCellCount read.
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.claim: C6-F1 fixed: MapComponentTick rebuilds dirty works (rope/pool cells) at once, so undrafted routing sees a ferry after load or pairing. C6-F8 same-bank pairing is NOT fixed. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.proposed_fix: Rebuild dirty works (rope/pool cells) promptly so routing sees the ferry. Same-bank pairing would need an opposite-bank test.
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.text: Ferry rope cells are built only when something reads them, so undrafted routing can ignore a valid ferry after load or pairing. Ferry posts also pair with the nearest unpaired post even on the same bank.

finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.accept: Live: a thirsty pawn beside a chemfuel, oil or poison canal fill does not drink it.
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.claim: 24 hazard fill terrains now use the inert RM_Liquid_NotDrinkable terrain, so they are no longer drunk as fresh water; selftest green. (recorded on pre-landing bd36286c4795; landed as 015b7892e833)
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.proposed_fix: Stop hazard fill terrains being tagged as drinkable water: switch them to an inert non-drinkable terrain (RM_Liquid_NotDrinkable).
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.text: Hazardous canal fill terrains (e.g. chemfuel) carry Water/WaterFreshShallow tags and no terrainSuite registers them, so thirst falls back to fresh water and pawns drink chemfuel, propane, poison or boiling water as potable, with the canal quantity unchanged.

finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.accept: PrePortFixChecks P8, old-path can-fail: burn pulse consumes a canal level only when the cell liquid burns now.
finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.proposed_fix: Consume a canal level in the burn pulse only when the cell liquid burns now, and keep the fire check interval below the pulse floor.
finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.text: The liquid-fire burn pulse may consume replacement water that refilled the cell (RM_LiquidFire.cs ~428-450); the path was unverified and had to be reproduced before fixing.

finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.accept: PrePortFixChecks P5 (old rule 36 vs 9); live: a release into a dug D4 channel spends 4 x volumePerTile per cell on the debug report.
finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.proposed_fix: Debit volumePerTile per level added and fill only payable levels.
finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.text: A flood fills a D4 cell for only one volumePerTile (Flood_FlowWorks.cs ~333-343 vs RM_MapComponent_Excavation.cs ~1256-1261) instead of debiting the full depth filled.

finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.accept: A release into a dry dug channel leaves FillAt>0, no flood temp terrain, and nothing strips it at recede.
finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.proposed_fix: Split TrySetDriverFill's false via TrySetDriverFillOutcome so Refused cells are left alone; a release into a dry dug channel leaves engine fill with no flood temp terrain.
finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.text: Legacy flood conflicts with the engine's temp terrain, and TrySetDriverFill's single false conflates refusal reasons.

finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.accept: A SelfTest/python case or live read red on old code, green with the fix; for PLAUSIBLE findings, run the check in the row first (kernel scene compare, round-trip, release beside wet vs dry inlet).
finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.claim: C5-F11 fixed: CanFloodInto no longer refuses a wet DUG cell before the engine decides (ViaEngine/HandsOff). (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)

finding:OUTFLOW_REGRESSION_FIX_HARDCODED.text: fw_pond_outflow_regression.py:14 hardcodes CAP=30, but capacity is bed levels x volumePerTile (shallow bed = 2 notches), so 'drained' is inflated: an undrained pond can report drained=18 and pass. Channel fills are never asserted.

finding:PIT_ENTRY_PROVE_DONE_BUT_STILL_R.proposed_fix: Separate regression from mod_completion miscount; re-prove ladder and ramp entry/exit live; file any miscount against mod_completion.
finding:PIT_ENTRY_PROVE_DONE_BUT_STILL_R.text: RM_Ladder and RM_PitRamp are listed broken by mod_completion because WATERED_PIT_FIX_NO_WAY_IN (done) and PIT_CLIMB_PROVE_RAIDERS_VS_SHEER_TRENCH carry a non-pass latest verify; real regression or instrument miscount was unseparated.

finding:PIT_FALL_MEND_SAVED_MIDAIR.accept: Pause, jump, save, reload: the descent still happens; a SelfTest/python case red on old code, green with the fix.
finding:PIT_FALL_MEND_SAVED_MIDAIR.claim: TryJumpInto resolves the arrival at once by the detector's own test (ResolveArrivalNow -> OnForcedDescent, which marks it handled), so a paused jump saved before unpausing still falls. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:PIT_FALL_MEND_SAVED_MIDAIR.proposed_fix: Resolve the arrival at once in TryJumpInto rather than deferring to the detector.
finding:PIT_FALL_MEND_SAVED_MIDAIR.text: A save in the same tick as a jump or forced fall loses the fall damage: RM_SuperdeepTrapState.lastCell is derived, never scribed, and TryJumpInto defers the descent to the next detector pass.

finding:PIT_PRISON_JUDGE_D3_ROOMS.accept: SelfTest PitRooms_pit_prison_room_is_superdeep_only (source-level, runs in-game); no live D3 check filed.
finding:PIT_PRISON_JUDGE_D3_ROOMS.claim: IsPitCell now requires IsSuperdeepRaw, so a D3 person-band pocket no longer counts as a pit prison room. (recorded on pre-landing 116742f41ac3; landed as 0b459fc8527e)
finding:PIT_PRISON_JUDGE_D3_ROOMS.proposed_fix: Make RM_PitRooms.IsPitCell require IsSuperdeepRaw, per the ruling that pit prisons are superdeep (D4) only.
finding:PIT_PRISON_JUDGE_D3_ROOMS.text: A sheer D3 person-band pocket formed a pit prison room, but capture-down and lip service need D4 (superdeep).

finding:PIT_RAIN_FIX_FRACTIONAL_HEADROOM.proposed_fix: Fill the fractional headroom with rain before sending the rest to sheet overflow, rather than flooring room to whole notches.
finding:PIT_RAIN_FIX_FRACTIONAL_HEADROOM.text: Rain uses whole-notch RoomNotches; a part-filled cell with less than one notch of headroom returns 0, so all rain goes to surface overflow instead of filling the excavation.

finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.accept: Selftest PitRamp_walked_step_down_a_ramp_is_no_fall passes; L1: a raider walking down a 3-notch pit ramp takes no fall damage and no fall message.
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.claim: A walked step down a ramp is no longer classed as a fall, fixing the missing ramp exemption in the fall classification. (recorded on pre-landing e3b0a513a649; landed as 8c8bd865f358)
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.proposed_fix: Exempt a walked step down a ramp from IsFallingArrival/DescentFalls.
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.text: A captured hostile walking down a valid ramp (joins up to MaxSpan 3) takes fall damage: IsFallingArrival judges by NaturalClimbLimitOf with no ramp exemption, and DescentFalls exempts only ladders/gear.

finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.accept: Live: flyer ordered from surface onto a ladderless D4 floor; K3 animal up a sheer D3 step; K2 width-2 pawn in a 1-cell D4 hole, read IsHeld and a path to the surface.
finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.claim: StartPath now records its walker and the veto answers for it (vanilla StartPath ran a pawnless CanReach at person band, C3-F4); masks and step floor step aside for a pawn too wide for its pocket (C3-F5). (recorded on pre-landing 009abe3c49; landed as 9b22587f388a)
finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.proposed_fix: Have StartPath record its walker so the veto answers for it; make masks and step floor step aside for a pawn too wide for its pocket.
finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.text: Pawnless reachability uses the person band with no flyer exemption, so flyers and K3+ pawns may be refused valid routes; a pawn too wide for its hole reads 'not held' but the cliff masks still wall it in.

finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.accept: Run validation_v2 phase P (P4/P4f), reload the fixture at an earlier tick, run again: the held friendly re-plans to the ladder; no red error naming RM_SuperdeepTrap / RM_Patch_PathFollower_SuperdeepFloor in Player.log.
finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.proposed_fix: Reset the static per-game cooldown state on load and key the trap-region cache by map.
finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.text: The pit reroute cooldown survives a reload, so an earlier save refuses re-plans; the trap-region cache ignores the map.

finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.accept: Selftest PitRescue_only_a_colonist_assigned_Doctor_counts_as_a_rescuer passes; L1: a downed pawn in a pit whose only reachable colonist has Doctor unticked still gets the rescue ladder.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.claim: Only a colonist assigned Doctor now counts as a rescuer, so an unticked Doctor no longer suppresses the rescue ladder. (recorded on pre-landing e3b0a513a649; landed as 8c8bd865f358)
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.proposed_fix: Count only colonists actually assigned Doctor, i.e. those vanilla DoctorRescue would send.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.text: AnyRescuerReaches counts colonists with Doctor unchecked in the Work tab as rescuers: WorkTypeIsDisabled tests capability, not the work assignment, so they suppress the rescue ladder indefinitely.

finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_UNREACHABLE_SPARE.proposed_fix: Check that an installer can reach the minified ladder in SparePortable before choosing it, else build a new ladder.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_UNREACHABLE_SPARE.text: SparePortable has no reachability check, so an unreachable minified ladder (e.g. in a sealed chamber) is chosen over building one; its install blueprint can never complete and later attempts decline to build another, stalling rescue.

finding:PIT_SHOT_PROOF_FIX_OTHER_TARGET_.proposed_fix: Make the P7 row fail on a different pick only when it proves eb was unhittable, e.g. by removing other hostiles or checking eb's hittability directly.
finding:PIT_SHOT_PROOF_FIX_OTHER_TARGET_.text: P7_shoot_between_7m_pits_refused passes whenever the picked target differs from eb, so if eb becomes a legal target but the AI picks another hostile, the row still passes.

finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.accept: In-game FlowWorks selftest PitTravel_every_trap_mask_reach_and_fall_read_asks_it passes with the one-pattern count (>=2) on the shipped RM_SuperdeepTrap.
finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.proposed_fix: Replace the summed same-line + \s* patterns with one \s* pattern counted once, so a dropped detector reads 1 < 2.
finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.text: In PitTravel_every_trap_mask_reach_and_fall_read_asks_it, two regexes (same-line and \s*) both match both arrival detectors, giving 4 matches. The >=2 assertion still passes with the free-traveller guard removed from one detector.

finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.accept: Each confirmed finding gets a SelfTest/python case that goes red on the old code and green with the fix.
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.claim: C1-F13 and C2-F6 now place through RM_LiquidBottleUtility.PlacePaidFor (Near, else spawn on the cell; a revert inside a container drops to the ground). C5-F12: the dig find charges the merged share. C6-F9: weir Deposit returns what merged. (recorded on pre-landing 8fdc692b89; landed as b7b7c3b3df58)
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.proposed_fix: Place paid-for items via RM_LiquidBottleUtility.PlacePaidFor (Near, else spawn on the cell). Charge the merged share for dig finds. Make weir Deposit return what merged.
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.text: After a debit, TryPlaceThing failures lose the product: reaction item products, fill-from-tank and liquid revert, dig finds merged partly into a stack (not charged to the find budget), and weir catches merged partly (fish created without debiting stock).

finding:PLACER_SELFCHECK_FIX_LEAVES_MERG.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test.
finding:PLACER_SELFCHECK_FIX_LEAVES_MERG.proposed_fix: none stated in the record; the item only records the defect. Cleanup must remove quantity merged into pre-existing stacks, not just new Thing identities (RM_PlacerWorks.cs:708-746).
finding:PLACER_SELFCHECK_FIX_LEAVES_MERG.text: RM_PlacerProof.SelfCheck cleanup tracks only newly created Thing ids. Generated ore that merged into an existing stack survives, so repeated selfchecks change colony resources and contaminate later live-state measurements.

finding:POCKET_TRAP_FIX_LADDER_TO_SEALED.accept: none, the ticket filed no acceptance test.
finding:POCKET_TRAP_FIX_LADDER_TO_SEALED.proposed_fix: Check whether the ladder graph reaches an escapable component, not just the first component boundary (RM_PocketGrid.cs:822-823).
finding:POCKET_TRAP_FIX_LADDER_TO_SEALED.text: RM_PocketGrid.TrappedIn passes a one-hop UsableLadderIn to Trapped. A ladder into another sealed pocket reads as an escape, so a stranded upright colonist returns not-trapped and gets no TryQueueFor rescue assistance.

finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.accept: TransferChecks Transfer_site_pump_draw_pond_to_the_last_decilitre passes; live pond_pump.py --drain: POND_PUMP_drains_to_last_dl and POND_PUMP_dry_squares_stage pass.
finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.proposed_fix: Make site pump draw from a natural pond down to the last decilitre when exact-level is on; off keeps the sub-notch remainder. Squares stage to mud/bed once dry.
finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.text: A natural pond did not pump to the last decilitre as a dug channel does. With exact-level on, a pump should drain it to 0 dL.

finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.accept: FlowWorks selftest Recession_order_spares_an_OUTFLOW_cell_until_last; live northstar/live_probes/fw_pond_outflow_regression.py PASS on a fresh site.
finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.proposed_fix: Recession keeps cells with live outflow (spares an outflow cell until last), or treats the pond as one level, so a channel or pump drains the pond.
finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.text: A limited pond recedes the very cell its channel draws from, stranding about 80% of stock. Measured live: a 6-cell pond with an 8-cell channel drains 6 of 30 and stops.

finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.accept: Production RM_DriverInputs + kernel: after reload a brimming pump outlet re-marks and the dug-on channel fills (selftest_flowworks_stock.py). Live: pump against a saved brimming outlet, reloaded and dug on, spreads into the extension.
finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.proposed_fix: Write the brimming-outlet reload test first; fix only if it fails.
finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.text: A pump-fed channel may stall after reload because driverInputTick is unsaved (RM_MapComponent_Excavation.cs ~1483-1485, 1196-1200). Write the brimming-outlet reload test first and fix only if it fails.

finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.accept: Selftest Pump_pour_is_faster_than_gravity; live fw_live_checks L2_pump_pour_drains_dump_fast PASS (L2b drainedPer1000 > L2a).
finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.proposed_fix: Use pour budget RM_PumpMath.PourLevels(levelsPerCycle, dumpUnitsPerCycle) = max(levelsPerCycle, dumpUnitsPerCycle/5 + 1), always at least one level above gravity.
finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.text: The basic RM_LiquidPump on Pour drains a Dump tank at 5 units/cycle, the same as the gravity rate, although ruling Q3 says pour is the fast drain. Live: 20 vs 25 units per 1000 ticks.

finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.accept: RaiderTrenchChecks 6/6 offline; live raid_trench_proof rows RAID_SHALLOW_FILLED_IN_RAID, RAID_DEEP_NOT_FILLED, RAID_NO_MELEE_GOES_AROUND, plus ladder, siege, and jump rows A2-A7.
finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.proposed_fix: Order: jump (pack or leap) → scaling ladders → breach fill only for melee raiders when the pit is at or under the fill line (hand-dig cap 4 = 2 m). Deeper pits: shoot, walk to a cast position, or leave. Via JobGiver_RM_CrossTrench in AssaultColony.
finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.text: Raiders facing an uncrossable trench stalled. When no colonist is reachable and the target is on another climb-band component, they must jump, scale ladders, or breach by shovelling a causeway (melee only, pit at or under the 4-square fill line); sieges are unchanged.

finding:RAIDER_CHOP_FIX_AXE_NEVER_LANDS.accept: LADDER_PARITY_RAIDER_FELLS_TREE reads PASS (no acceptance test filed beyond this row).
finding:RAIDER_CHOP_FIX_AXE_NEVER_LANDS.proposed_fix: none stated in the record; make the chop job actually fell the tree.
finding:RAIDER_CHOP_FIX_AXE_NEVER_LANDS.text: Ladderless raiders take RM_RaiderChopForLadder jobs for about 8000 ticks and never fell an oak: in raid_trench r55, 6 of 6 Plant_TreeOak stood with no stump.

finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.accept: Selftest Drawbridge_raid_plank_between_sunken_banks_lies_at_their_depth passes (FlowWorks SelfTest); live: with sunken bridges on, a plank between two 4-notch banks reads deck at ledge depth and pawns cross.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.claim: Fixed in source (e3b0a513a649 (pre-landing; landed as 8c8bd865f358)) so a raid plank between sunken banks lies at their depth; selftest went red then green. Live check still owed.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.proposed_fix: In RM_RaidPlanks.TryLay (RM_DrawbridgeRaid.cs:295-303) set deckNotches on the plank record to the banks' depth so the deck lies at ledge depth.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.text: RaidPlankFits accepts equal-height banks at any depth, but the raid plank record never sets deckNotches (left zero), so a plank between sunken banks is registered as a surface deck. Access, draw height, underpass class and fall distance come out wrong.

finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.accept: Selftests Reach_veto_needs_a_way_at_both_ends and Map_edge_island_ringed_by_a_trench_is_cut_off go red on old code, green with the fix.
finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.claim: ReachVetoed now needs a way at both ends (C3-F8, C4-F2); the map-edge veto cuts off a surface island via TouchesEdge (C3-F9); the absolute-rule BFS stops at walls (C3-F12). (recorded on pre-landing 009abe3c49; landed as 9b22587f388a)
finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.proposed_fix: Require a way at BOTH ends in ReachVetoed (RM_PocketGridMath.cs:184-187); cut off a surface island in the map-edge veto via TouchesEdge; stop the absolute-rule BFS at walls.
finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.text: ReachVetoed vetoed only when both ends lacked a way, so a laddered pocket was approved to reach a sealed pocket (and the reverse) and A* then failed, looping jobs on PatherFailed. The map-edge check let a surface island ringed by an unclimbable trench believe it could leave

finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.accept: none, no acceptance test filed; implied: selftest_flowworks_stock.py goes green.
finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.proposed_fix: Repoint the RewireChecks.cs:203 pattern to the DepthSuffix form that ProofReadout now uses.
finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.text: FlowWorks SelfTest Readout_two_numbers_and_the_limitless_mark fails: RewireChecks.cs:203 still expects RM_NorthstarProofs to contain 'return "OK " + (eng.DepthReadoutAt(c) ?? "-")', which 56bd0e0876 replaced with DepthSuffix. selftest_flowworks_stock.py is red on main.

finding:READOUT_SELFTEST_MEND_PATTERN_LO.accept: none filed; the verify event recorded 'RewireChecks.cs:203 greps DepthSuffix' as pass.
finding:READOUT_SELFTEST_MEND_PATTERN_LO.proposed_fix: Repoint the RewireChecks.cs:203 pattern to RM_Patch_MouseoverDepth.DepthSuffix.
finding:READOUT_SELFTEST_MEND_PATTERN_LO.text: SelfTest Readout_two_numbers_and_the_limitless_mark is red: RewireChecks.cs:203 greps RM_NorthstarProofs.cs for a line removed by 56bd0e0876, since ProofReadout now reads RM_Patch_MouseoverDepth.DepthSuffix.

finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.accept: none, no command filed; verification is an offline kernel read or a sheet selftest.
finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.proposed_fix: Verify via offline kernel read or sheet selftest, then either let the residue dry/flow or document it as intended.
finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.text: When a wet square becomes a Receiver/Sink, HandOverTakenCells credits it to the engine; what the channel refuses (full, or another liquid) stays on the square. On a dug/lake cell evaporation and soak are 0 and kernel flow skips non-HoldsSheet kinds, so the residue may never leave. Unverified live.

finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_COVER_NEW_DEFS.claim: selftest_review_map + selftest_extensions pass at HEAD d2c7a3a835 (pre-landing; landed as 1a62baf78407)
finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_COVER_NEW_DEFS.proposed_fix: Add review_map_coverage.py rules for the uncovered items and add the 2 settings to the extensions toggle floor.
finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_COVER_NEW_DEFS.text: selftest_review_map and selftest_extensions were red at HEAD: 18 inventory items (RM_LadderSteel, 8 RM_BankStake/RM_SiltTrap ThingStyleDefs, 4 RM_Fleck_SprinklerDrop_N, settings pipeStraightVariants and sprinklerSprayEffects) lacked review_map_coverage.py rules, and the extensions toggle floor lacked the 2 settings.

finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_STATIONS_NO_LEAD_.accept: Every station hose lays with layOk true; for stations 35/36 none filed beyond finding the cause.
finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_STATIONS_NO_LEAD_.proposed_fix: Lay out the stations so every hose has room for the straight lead-out (owner rule, HoseReviewChecks B5). For 35/36, determine whether the builder reads the wrong label (harness) or the ladder never reaches up (mod).
finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_STATIONS_NO_LEAD_.text: In review_map.py, hose lays at stations 63, 66 and 67 are refused ('no room for the straight lead-out from the nozzle', layOk false), so those stations show no hose. At stations 35/36 'Ladder' never reads 'Ladder up'.

finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.accept: The held gate reads open=True in the stage's own log; the stage refuses or fits on a 250 map before staging; the shooter is armed or the row says it cannot be.
finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.proposed_fix: Read map size and fit the layout or refuse with a reason before staging; read door state after gate_open and print its full report; arm the trench shooter with a ranged weapon or have the row say it cannot be.
finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.text: owner_review_stage.py places bars_* rows off-map on a 250 map (bars site at origin+150) without checking map size. Held-open gates read open=False after gate_open though by hand the mod holds them open. The bars_trench shooter has no ranged verb.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ADVANCE_FLOWWORKS_OF.accept: none, the pipeline's own stages judge it.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ADVANCE_FLOWWORKS_OF.proposed_fix: Follow design/specs/2026-11-13-maturation-pipeline.md; deliver design/concepts/FlowWorks/journal.md, version/test_table.json and version/preflight.json.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ADVANCE_FLOWWORKS_OF.text: Take FlowWorks 0.1.0 (locked) through the maturation pipeline's offline stages by hand, to stage 5 at most, no game: journal, bars-to-tests table with stages, throwaway preflight.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.accept: none filed as a command; the blind fault's would_pass is: the delay in days survives a pulse-slider change.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.proposed_fix: Store the delay in ticks or days and derive pulses at use.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.text: cropDrownPulses ships 1680 = 7 days at the shipped 250-tick pulse, but it is stored in pulses, so moving the pulse slider (60..2500) changes the delay to 1.68..70 days.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BREAK_PIT_COVER_UNDE.accept: Live: the cover row of `knockback_runner.py --scenes storeroom_bomb_pit --ticks 900` reads cover=True. Plus an offline check that a stack landing on a covered cell destroys the cover and descends once; watch it fail on the base.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BREAK_PIT_COVER_UNDE.proposed_fix: Build it: a landing thrown stack on a covered pit cell breaks the cover and falls through once. The record favours the Knockback-side flyer landing over widening SpanDeck's walking-pawn load, which would change every item dropped on a deck.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BREAK_PIT_COVER_UNDE.text: ExplosiveKnockback scene sc_storeroom_bomb_pit expects a thrown stack on a covered pit cell to fall through with one descent and destroy the cover, but no code does it. Building_SpanDeck's load counts living walking pawns only, and RM_ThingFlyer_Knockback never touches a cover.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_COAT.accept: `python3 src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/selftest_stage3_owed.py --only coating` red on base, green on the build
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_COAT.proposed_fix: Build the RM_LiquidCoat hediff and its apply/wash tick, and make the scene row require a coat seen before the water.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_COAT.text: After wading oil a pawn gets no coating condition (scene sc_coating_wash FAIL, row 67), and COAT_water_washes_it passed vacuously with no coat on the pawn. The bar's three laws (coat HediffDef, applied on leaving a staining liquid, washed in water) were unbuilt.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_TOSS.accept: `python3 src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/selftest_stage3_owed.py --only toss_flame` red on base, green on the build; live `concept_scenes.py --scene scene_toss_flame --out <json>` with both rows PASS.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_TOSS.proposed_fix: Build the RM_TossFlame JobDef, job driver and float-menu option, with a settings switch.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_TOSS.text: The 'toss a flame' order does not exist: sc_toss_flame FAILs with 'Unknown JobDef RM_TossFlame', and TOSS_picked_square_lights_first and TOSS_control_water_twin_stays_dark fail.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.accept: none filed; the record suggests a matrix scene with RM_Fill_Water_Superdeep to guard it.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.proposed_fix: Designer to decide whether a cord should dive under swim-depth water that is def-Standable. If yes, add a terrain tag or DefModExtension on FlowWorks' swim-depth terrains that GSS reads by name, and settle dug-depth cells that are swim-deep only via the excavation component.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.text: Gimme Some Slack draws a waterproof conduit across FlowWorks' RM_Fill_Water_Superdeep (2 m+) as one cord lying on the water, battery to consumer. The same crossing over vanilla WaterDeep dives with two water stubs at the banks. Deep swim on or off makes no difference.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHALLENGE_FLOWWORKS_.accept: `maturation.py next FlowWorks` reads exit met: five offline bars green, 8 deciders PASS, problems_open 0.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHALLENGE_FLOWWORKS_.proposed_fix: Run lane 1 (blind rows), lane 2 (offline reruns and planted faults), fix Problems red-first, then advance with `maturation.py advance FlowWorks --to in_game` or open cycle 2.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHALLENGE_FLOWWORKS_.text: FlowWorks 0.1.0 needs blind challenge cycle 1: independent tests written blind, then reruns and planted faults, ending in an exit that `maturation.py next FlowWorks` reads.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.accept: Live: live-proof A1 of RIMMANDRAKE_PROVE_FLOWWORKS_TOGGLES_DENSE reads shooting_rule_off and shooting_rule_on_pit_only PASS, or the row is rewritten to vanilla's rule and a mutant (rule forced on) fails it. Offline: none.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.proposed_fix: Read vanilla AttackTargetFinder for the scene's verb and range before changing either side. Either fix the mod if OFF does not restore vanilla targeting, or rewrite the row to vanilla's real rule.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.text: With the superdeep shooting rule OFF, the shooter picks a farther target (11098) than the nearer pit enemy (Human11094). Chain toggle_superdeep_shooting row shooting_rule_off FAILs; shooting_rule_on_pit_only reads UNMEASURED.

trap:a-1-unit-bottle-only-moves-liquid-a.text: A 1-unit bottle only moves liquid at a capacity factor >= 1.5, so the bottle capacity column reads 1/1/1 for leather, glass and metal.

trap:a-bank-end-sitting-gaps-proof-s-s3.text: A bank end (sitting_gaps_proof's S3['outflow_bank']) may not be enough: S3.a/S3.b need the outflow to pour into the canal.

trap:a-dry-cell-s-row-has-no-fluid.text: A dry cell's row has no fluid key (null omitted by the bridge JSON); a check testing 'fluid' not in row reports a false missing field.

trap:a-green-entry-with-no-step-4-record.text: A GREEN entry with no step-4 record (e.g. a `modcheck run`, or any pre-contract entry) reads step4 UNMEASURED, not PASS; only a stored PASS at the current mod hash counts.

trap:a-hose-end-pushed-onto-the-pump-squ.text: A hose end pushed onto the pump square, or touching only a corner, is refused; a tank touching the pump is not a port.

trap:a-map-edge-fed-source-is-eaten-by.text: A map-edge-fed source is eaten by the edge SINK band (x<=9), so a big-network timing needs an inland limitless source. The measured pulse cost, 7.5-7.7 ms per pulse incl. the bridge round trip, is what decides whether the default maxNetworkCells 6000 rises.

trap:a-mod-fail-on-a-rerun-without-fresh.text: A MOD FAIL on a rerun without --fresh-map is not a mod fault. The cut and chunk succeed, and the letter is withheld because the map remembers the chunk was already discovered. The rectangle reset in RM_NorthstarProofs.cs clears rolled depths, not the discovery set.

trap:a-new-cs-file-not-in-the-csproj-com.text: RimMandrake_FlowWorks.csproj lists every .cs explicitly: a new file not added there builds green and ships nothing, while source-law selftests (selftest_stage3_owed.py) still read it and pass. fetch_fallen now has a csproj law; toss_flame and coating do not (their files are listed today).

trap:wall-face-tuning-d3-about-0-25-cell.text: Wall-face tuning (D3 about 0.25 cell, 85% lip hide, 0.3/level sink) is PROVISIONAL; the near-lip 85% hide is overridden for occupied cells by a 1-cell window.

trap:water-lost-to-soak-on-the-soil-pad.text: Water lost to soak on the soil pad is a disclosed exit, not a leak; F3 conservation allows start minus (Soaked + Evaporated).

trap:water-spills-as-a-surface-fill-not-.text: Water spills as a surface fill, not filth, so L5 water runs do not exercise the clean half. The 20261022 L5 FAIL could not tell water-home from loss until PlacedInWaterUnits/PlacedNearbyUnits counters were added (L5 SITE when drained to water, MOD FAIL on any uncounted unit).

trap:whether-the-post-deploy-first-launc.text: Whether the post-deploy first launch matters is unproven; the restart also does a `down` first.

trap:which-step-flipped-a-water-type-on-.text: Which step flipped a water type on the Contagion map (tick 824016, tile 55631) was not traced; any type flip triggers the throw and the fix covers every route.

trap:while-the-leaf-is-raised-there-is-n.text: While the leaf is raised there is no passing deck, so pawns on the exposed floor carry no floor-band flag, and SweepUnder also clears existing flags. A pawn that stays put through the lowering therefore ends up on the deck.

trap:with-the-cut-on-the-sunk-occupant-r.text: With the cut on, the sunk occupant reads as standing in front of the pit rather than in it; needs the owner's L4 look.

trap:works-ferry-rope-reads-unmeasured-o.text: works/ferry_rope reads UNMEASURED on the wide (size 2.50) river and skips the rest of works; this is a site issue, not this item.

trap:worktypeisdisabled-reads-capability.text: WorkTypeIsDisabled reads capability, not the player's Work-tab setting, so it does not mean Doctor is switched off. The live check is still owed.

trap:x1-is-known-red-on-the-sink-cap.text: X1 is known-red on the sink cap, so a red X1 does not by itself show a regression of the widening.
